summary: Frontend-only P0 validation executed on preview URL across scenario flows, draft lifecycle, recovery paths, analytics/KPI matrix, responsive views, migration, and reset. Most critical flows passed; one reproducible duplicate-indicator issue found.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking repeat-message-button on a linked draft flow, duplicate-message-count did not render even though duplicate action was triggered.

integration_issues.issue: User-visible duplication counter did not appear in repeated runs, reducing operator traceability for duplicate suppression.

action_items: Fix repeat-message-button UI feedback so duplicate-message-count is reliably shown after duplicate events.
Re-run targeted checks for paused-assistant handoff path and approval-guard edge cases (stock/price drift) with deterministic scripted order selection.
After fix, re-verify duplicate event visibility in both flow tab and analytics session duplicate counters.
critical_code_review_comments: FlowPanel depends on flow.duplicateCount for duplicate visibility, but runtime behavior did not render duplicate-message-count in tested linked-draft flow.
Scenario createFlowDraft auto-opens OrderDialog; tests and UX expectations should explicitly account for this modal-first transition to avoid hidden state confusion.
Several interaction paths are modal/overlay-sensitive; keep explicit post-close wait before sidebar navigation to prevent overlay interception.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Final environment was reset to pristine defaults (session counters zero, stocks restored p1=42/p2=28/p3=8/p4=35). Validated passes: normal draft path with edit->revision->approve->complete, variant/stock/address/shipping/failure recoveries, plain text local reply without auto-draft, KPI baseline/target matrix values, historical totals (7-day and 30-day), mobile 390/360 reachability and no horizontal overflow, localStorage legacy migration to schema 2 safe defaults.
rca of the issue: Repro steps for duplicate indicator: reset demo -> start normal scenario -> check requirements -> create draft -> close order dialog -> click repeat-message-button. Expected: duplicate-message-count appears and increments. Observed: counter not rendered (0 nodes) while duplicate-related notice/events indicate duplicate handling path executed. Likely root cause: state/visibility mismatch between flow.duplicateCount updates and linked-draft rendering branch refresh. Mitigation: assert duplicateCount state transition in FlowPanel render path and add regression UI test for linked-draft duplicate actions.
